title: Fuzzer: `CameraFeed.get_texture_tex_id` crashes Godot
body:

- 4.8.dev.custom_build (2c089e9bf)

### System information

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable126 = CameraFeed.new()
	temp_variable126.get_texture_tex_id(66)

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29937856/mrp.zip)
